title: Glasswing Loop
generation_prompt: Original all-ages melodic-house instrumental for a one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 127 BPM in 4/4 for one continuous 128-second performance. Begin at the FIRST AUDIO SAMPLE with a full-strength, clearly audible four-on-the-floor kick on EVERY quarter beat, a dry clap on beats two and four, crisp closed eighth-note hats, and a short pitched glass-mallet pluck on EVERY beat. Maintain the kick, clap, hats and short pluck at stable foreground level across the entire performance, including the first 16 seconds, the 64-second game boundary, the complete 64-128-second music-station extension and the final beat. There is NO intro, fade, ramp, breakdown, silence, percussion dropout, half-time switch, tempo drift or washy ambient interlude. Over that continuous grid, introduce a memorable original three-note glass-mallet phrase that rises, skips one scale step, then answers with a lower two-note echo. Use a rounded offbeat bass, gentle sidechained warm chords and small syncopated woodblock replies, keeping the melody easy to follow and the highs controlled. After the midpoint, keep every drum and pluck in place while the answering echo moves to a higher register, the bass root changes and the chord voicing turns brighter; finish with a new descending cadence, still over the unchanged beat. Clear transients and distinct sections without removing the pulse. No vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of an existing song.
cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original duohertz album cover for Glasswing Loop, an all-ages melodic-house rhythm-game track. Use the brand's original high-contrast editorial comic-print collage: near-black ink, warm-ivory cut paper, coral red and electric cyan with sparse large halftone. Main motif: ONE broad continuous electric-cyan looping soundline forms an open tilted figure-eight, with exactly FOUR large angular warm-ivory glasswing-like paper fins attached at its turning points, two fins carrying coral underside cuts. The fins should suggest a light rhythmic glide, not a realistic insect or transparent crystal. Place one tiny warm-yellow beat diamond where the two lobes nearly meet. Bold, asymmetrical silhouette readable at 100px and distinct from duohertz frequency rings, paper planes, flowers and prism diamonds; quiet dark lower fifth for a separate local title overlay. No photorealism, insect body, character, landscape, sky, stars, water, text, numbers, letters, logo, watermark or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Glasswing Loop square cover into a HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve ONE broad electric-cyan open figure-eight soundline, exactly FOUR warm-ivory angular glasswing-like paper fins at its turns, two coral underside cuts and a tiny warm-yellow beat diamond. Recompose this distinct cut-paper loop on the RIGHT two-thirds against near-black editorial comic-print ink with restrained halftone; leave calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines on the left: 'duohertz' all lowercase in electric cyan and 'Glasswing Loop' larger in warm ivory. Spell both exactly. Purpose-build the wide layout; do not stretch the square. No other text, letters, numbers, realistic insect, glass crystal, stars, landscape, people, logo, watermark or copied game art.
